name: Carelane
summary: A seven-page clinic CRM with a WhatsApp inbox, a patient board, visits and message templates
about: A seven-page app for a clinic front desk to manage patients, visits and WhatsApp messages. The inbox has chat threads, a reply box, quick replies and templates beside a patient card with its board stage, and the patient board, visit schedule, templates and reports all share the same sample data. Good for a family clinic, a dentist, a physio or any practice that books by chat.
how: Open Inbox, pick a chat and reply: Enter sends, ticks turn blue when read and patients sometimes write back
Insert a template or a quick reply; {name}, {date} and {time} fill in from the patient's next visit
Set the patient's board stage from the side panel, tag them, save a desk note or book a visit
New messages arrive by themselves every so often with a typing indicator and an unread badge
Open Patient board and drag patients from New enquiry to Follow-up; click a card to chat in a drawer
Drag visits between doctors and times, move today's patients from waiting to done, and send reminders
Edit templates, broadcast to a stage, read the funnel and message charts, and reset the demo in Settings
